conditions.requires: Oceanic Realms 1.0.7 artifact SHA256 8f346b75b8b1c6d28b069924fe0aed374c3820997dae765698c3a140eccf2321 and enabled Paxi jem-oceanic-worldgen-safety datapack

change.summary: Keep Oceanic Realms multi-block templates inside the native FEATURES write neighborhood

modifiers.notes: Template X/Z maximum offsets are 3, 6, 4 and 2 respectively. Beach reserves one additional block for native StructureTemplate edge shape updates. Other three use processBlockInfos plus BulkSectionAccess with no template neighbor update pass.

modifiers.before: Native in_square chooses each horizontal coordinate in [0,15]; inner patch adds [-1,1]; maximum template offset is 17
modifiers.after: Native random_offset independently chooses X and Z uniformly in [2,13]; inner patch remains [-1,1], keeping the complete rotated/mirrored template in [-16,31] relative to the generating chunk origin
modifiers.notes: Retain all three native templates, all rotations/mirrors, biome and water predicates, heightmap and native one-attempt patch. Other Oceanic Realms features remain native.

rationale.purpose: Prevent invalid far-chunk block writes and partial template placement without hiding logs, disabling content, increasing chunk write permissions or modifying third-party JARs
rationale.decision_source: User reported generation errors and freezes, then requested a thorough fix. Codex chose geometry-specific native datapack placement bounds after inspecting installed 1.0.7 bytecode, all 31 structure templates and Minecraft 1.20.1 placement/shape-update code

introduced.summary: Bound Oceanic Realms template placement using installed geometry while retaining native content and attempt counts

history.summary: Bound Oceanic Realms template placement using installed geometry while retaining native content and attempt counts

systems: Oceanic Realms coastal and ocean decoration
notes: Same code path applies to player-driven new chunk generation and Chunky
No registry IDs, models, templates, loot, biome memberships, patch attempt counts or internal probability gates change
Local placement distributions intentionally change. Exact realized decoration density depends on terrain and is not claimed identical
Existing chunks are not regenerated or repaired. Deep Dark Regrowth is outside this fix

Five Whys: error logged per block -> template reaches a non-writable chunk -> patch scatter plus template geometry exceeds FEATURES radius -> native mod data has no geometry margin and placer has no admission check -> pack data now supplies explicit template-specific safe admission coordinates
unresolved: User requested preparation only on 2026-10-24. Native publication, client application and runtime activation are intentionally pending
